resources.string: i live in the last bit of red, green, and blue, never alpha, never loud enough to see. tip the bit-plane and find me. next, a secret in sound.
hidden one bit at a time in the image\'s own colors. open the bit-plane view to see the layer where it hides.
above 1.5 khz, i nudge how loud a bin looks. silence gives me away. now, a song.
silence gives me away. try a song.
hidden in the loudness of frequencies above 1.5 khz. the difference view shows exactly which bins moved.
i\'m tones, one pitch for every four bits, mended by reed-solomon. now: watch.
four bits a pitch. now watch.
sent out loud as tones between about 2 and 6 khz, each pitch standing for four bits. the meadow listens for exactly these tones.
